source_functional.exact_nonlocal_source: J_A(x)=-(1/(2 sqrt(-g(x)))) integral d4y sqrt(-g(y)) T_m^{mu nu}(y) delta G_{mu nu}(y)/delta chi^A(x)
source_functional.exact_local_source: J_A=-(1/2) T_m^{mu nu} partial G_{mu nu}/partial chi^A
source_functional.stress_energy_role: physical measured matter source; not a fitted amplitude
source_functional.metric_response_role: PBUF-derived response kernel fixing which stress-energy projection loads each medium mode

requirements.role: Independent physical T^{mu nu}(x), including energy density and where relevant pressure/momentum/anisotropic stress.
requirements.derivation_rule: Must come from independent observations/physics in SI or a fully documented unit system; never from kappa.

requirements.role: R_{mu nu A}=delta G_{mu nu}/delta chi^A, or an equivalent normalized metric-medium map.
requirements.derivation_rule: Must be derived from the PBUF definition of the medium-to-metric map; no free matter coupling coefficient.

requirements.role: S_sigma or equivalent equations that determine propagation, stiffness and normalization of chi.
requirements.derivation_rule: Must be derived from frozen PBUF microphysics/constitutive dynamics and pass stability/causality checks.

requirements.role: Normalized C and P operators mapping chi/J_A into the finite lab state u and source s.
requirements.derivation_rule: Must be derived/documented before reducing full T^{mu nu} to a scalar/vector loading field.

requirements.role: Physical cell areas/volumes/depths and coordinate units needed to convert observed matter to T^{mu nu}(x).
requirements.derivation_rule: Must come from measured geometry/redshifts/calibration, not from lensing benchmark morphology.
